KISWAHILI — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Maamkuzi na Maagano.

3. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
